services.name: Rental Boats
services.desc: Currently based out of our Lavallette location is our rental fleet AquaRentz. Want to go fishing or crabbing, then our Boston Whaler is your match. Want to cruise along to F cove or Tices, then look no further than to one of our pontoons. Our fleet has an option for everyone! While we do encourage you to have a NJ boater safety certificate when renting our boats, one is not required. AquaRentz is the ultimate way to enjoy boating fun without the long term commitment. What are you waiting for? Go to AquaRentz’s website to find out more information and book your rental ahead of time

gap: Prices for boat rentals not stated
blurb: Ocean Beach Marine Centers operates two locations on Barnegat Bay offering boat rentals, marina services, and boat sales. They provide certified technicians for Mercury, MerCruiser, and Yamaha engines, as well as mobile service and various boat maintenance and repair services. Their locations are near popular water destinations like Tices Shoal, Silver Bay, and F-Cove.
extraNote: Lanoka Harbor location at 700 Barramore Ave. or Lavallette location at 3245 Route 35 South
